# Questions for client — outstanding inputs

None of these change the revenue or going-concern conclusions; they finalize the Ironvale lease measurement and balance-sheet classification. Answers will be incorporated on the next turn.

1. **Discount rate for the Ironvale lease.** What is Northwind's incremental borrowing rate (or the rate implicit in the Ironvale contract, if known) at commencement, 2025-10-01? The library requires the lease liability at the *present value* of payments but does not supply a rate; my draft uses 0% (undiscounted, $594,000 at 12/31/2025) as a clearly labeled upper bound.
2. **Lease vs. non-lease allocation.** Ironvale's $18,000/month includes power, cooling, and network (non-lease components per the library). Are there standalone prices or any allocation schedule in the full contract (Schedule B or similar)? Absent one, I assumed the entire $18,000 is the lease component; with an allocation the lease liability and ROU asset will decrease.
3. **Saltline receivable/cash.** Has Saltline paid the $210,000 invoice dated 2025-12-28? If paid, it is a refund liability/customer advance on the balance sheet; if unpaid, whether a receivable should be shown (vs. no entry) needs a collection assessment. Either way, Q4 revenue is $0.
4. **Costs tied to the reversed revenue.** The drafted P&L has no cost-of-sales line. Did Q4 records include hardware cost for the 120 Saltline kits or any incremental costs for Halvorsen that would need reversal/reclassification alongside the revenue adjustments? (Adjusted net loss shown as −$234,000 assumes none.)
5. **Confirmations.** Confirm there are no amendments, side agreements, or definitive agreements after the file dates for Halvorsen (LOI 12/19), Saltline (order 12/22, side letter 12/23), or Ironvale (agreement effective 10/1/2025).
